root_causes.description: The checkout pod cannot become Ready: after a deployment spec change restarted the checkout container, the pod sandbox image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest fails to pull (DeadlineExceeded/ErrImagePull), placing the container into ImagePullBackOff/back-off so checkout serves essentially no traffic.

evidence.observed_value: ImagePullBackOff count=4, ErrImagePull count=3, Back-off pulling image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest" count=4
evidence.expected_baseline: no image pull failures; container Running/Ready

evidence.query_or_id: Failed: Failed to pull image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest": rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = failed to pull a
evidence.observed_value: count=2 (plus 1 more variant) DeadlineExceeded on pause image pull
evidence.expected_baseline: successful image pull, pod sandbox ready

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted
evidence.observed_value: count=1 container restarted due to spec change
mean=0.018 req/s, p95=0.057, max=0.057 req/s (traffic collapsed)
evidence.expected_baseline: healthy checkout serving continuous request rate

evidence.observed_value: mean=0.000, max=0.000 errors/s (no server-side errors — pod not serving at all)

root_causes.description: Frontend shows elevated server errors (~0.06 errors/s) because its downstream dependency checkout is unavailable; this is a consequence of the checkout pod outage rather than an independent fault.

A transient memory working-set change was flagged on the checkout pods during the window, but the magnitude (~25 MB peak, CPU ~0.003 cores) is modest and does not explain the traffic collapse; treated as incidental.

evidence.expected_baseline: stable checkout working set without abrupt change

remediation_steps: Roll back the checkout Deployment to the previous working container definition — the event 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' shows a recent spec change triggered the outage.

Fix the sandbox image pull failure: the pull of gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest fails with DeadlineExceeded — verify registry connectivity/DNS, use an accessible mirror or pre-pulled image, or set imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent.
Restart/roll the checkout pod so it can pull the pause image and reach Ready, then confirm checkout request_rate recovers and frontend error_rate returns to < 0.01.
Add alerting on KubePodNotReady/ImagePullBackOff for checkout and validate image references in CI before applying deployment spec changes.
